title: Machine learning selects a plasma protein panel evaluated for Parkinson’s disease
summary: A two-stage study of 391 participants identified a five-protein plasma panel. The authors tested selected proteins in a separate cohort that included Parkinson’s disease, multiple system atrophy and healthy controls.
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University; Peking University First Hospital

evidence.tested: The study reports cohort-based discrimination and follow-up protein measurements using immunoassays.
evidence.unknown: The results do not establish prospective screening benefit or causal involvement of the proteins.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning feature selection derived candidate panels from the measured proteomics data.
